# Autovex Solutions

> Technology agency building AI-powered business-process automation first, plus
> custom software, web platforms, mobile apps and UI/UX design. Founder-led
> delivery (Huzaifa, Sudais, Ishaq); fixed-scope engagements shipped in weeks,
> with the expected return stated up front. Slogan: Innovate. Automate. Elevate.

## What we do

- AI Automations (core service): custom AI-powered workflows, chatbots and
  process automation — wiring CRM, inbox, sheets and invoicing into pipelines
  that run end to end. n8n + OpenAI, deterministic where it matters.
- Custom Software Development: internal tools to full-scale platforms, built
  around each client's business logic.
- Web: fast, search-friendly marketing sites and web apps (Next.js).
- Mobile: iOS and Android from one codebase (React Native).
- UI/UX Design: wireframes, prototypes and polished interfaces.

## How engagements work

Map (audit of where hours go) → Blueprint (fixed scope, expected return, typical
$3–10k over 3–6 weeks) → Build (working demo every Friday) → Run (monitor and improve).

## Free teardown

Email one workflow you hate to autovexsolutions@gmail.com and get back a teardown
within 48 hours: where the hours go, what we'd automate, what it saves per month.
